{"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Average temperature-0.8 masked-item cross-entropy within each sequence, then across sequences, giving sampled users equal weight regardless of masked-target count. Apply to all four category models while preserving sampling, architecture, inference and training settings.","edits":[{"find":"    return torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits / 0.8, targets, reduction="mean")","replace":"    target_losses = torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits / 0.8, targets, reduction="none")
    sequence_indices = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
    sequence_losses = target_losses.new_zeros(seq.size(0)).scatter_add(
        0, sequence_indices, target_losses
    )
    target_counts = mask.sum(dim=1).clamp_min(1).to(target_losses.dtype)
    return (sequence_losses / target_counts).mean()"}]}],"change_summary":"Replace global masked-target averaging with per-sequence loss averaging for all four BERT4Rec models. Checkpoint shapes and predictor remain compatible."}
